capabilities: Draw freehand strokes over Markdown notes
Add text annotations on the canvas
Erase partial strokes with a real stroke eraser
Move, delete, and scale drawn elements
Adjust stroke color, width, and opacity
disambiguation: Not a standalone drawing canvas; the sketches are drawn as an overlay on Markdown files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copying files into .obsidian/plugins).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw or annotate freehand on top of an existing Markdown note.
summary: Full-screen scratchpad that lets you hand-draw sketches and annotations directly over Markdown notes.
